context: A mobile financial management tool for users in Kenya, UAE, and Pakistan to manage personal finances, track expenses, create budgets, and monitor financial health. The tool must comply with regional data protection laws and financial regulations while providing secure, intuitive financial management capabilities for individual users and small businesses.

userStories.title: User Account Management
userStories.iWantTo: register and create a secure account
userStories.soThat: I can securely access and manage my financial data

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am on the registration screen
acceptanceCriteria.when: I enter valid personal details and submit
acceptanceCriteria.then: my account is created with encrypted credentials
I am authenticated and can access my dashboard
I can login using fingerprint or face ID

userStories.title: Expense Tracking
userStories.iWantTo: add and categorize my daily expenses
userStories.soThat: I can track where my money is being spent

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am on the expense entry screen
acceptanceCriteria.when: I enter amount, category, and description
acceptanceCriteria.then: the expense is saved and reflected in my balance
I see all expenses sorted by date with categories

userStories.title: Budget Management
userStories.soThat: I can control my spending and achieve financial goals

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am on the budget creation screen
acceptanceCriteria.then: budgets are saved and tracking begins
I see overspent categories highlighted in red

userStories.title: Multi-Currency Support
userStories.soThat: I can track expenses in KES, AED, and PKR

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am setting up my account
acceptanceCriteria.then: all amounts display in my chosen currency

acceptanceCriteria.given: I have transactions in different currencies
acceptanceCriteria.then: I see converted amounts using current exchange rates

userStories.title: Financial Reports
userStories.soThat: I can understand my spending patterns and financial health

acceptanceCriteria.given: I have transaction data for a month
acceptanceCriteria.then: I receive a PDF with expense breakdown and charts
report is generated for the specified period

userStories.title: Data Security & Compliance
userStories.iWantTo: have my financial data secured and compliant
userStories.soThat: my sensitive information is protected per local regulations

acceptanceCriteria.then: it is encrypted using AES-256 encryption
my data is permanently deleted within 30 days

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am accessing from different region
acceptanceCriteria.then: data residency rules are enforced per local laws

userStories.title: Offline Mode
userStories.soThat: I can track expenses without internet connection

acceptanceCriteria.then: data is stored locally on device
offline data syncs automatically with server

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am adding a new bill
acceptanceCriteria.then: notification is scheduled for specified date/time

acceptanceCriteria.given: a bill is due in 3 days
acceptanceCriteria.then: I receive push notification with bill details

functionalRequirements.description: System must provide secure user authentication with multi-factor authentication support
System must track and categorize financial transactions with automatic classification
System must enable budget creation and monitoring with real-time alerts
System must support multi-currency operations with real-time exchange rates
System must generate comprehensive financial reports with visualizations
System must ensure data security and regulatory compliance for all regions
System must provide offline functionality with automatic synchronization
System must manage bill reminders and recurring payment notifications

errorAndEdgeCases: Network connectivity loss during transaction submission
Exchange rate API failure requiring fallback to cached rates
Concurrent modification of budget from multiple devices
Biometric authentication failure requiring password fallback
Data sync conflicts when offline changes conflict with server
Payment gateway timeout during subscription renewal
Storage capacity exceeded on mobile device
Invalid currency conversion for unsupported currencies
Rate limiting on third-party financial data APIs
Partial data corruption requiring recovery procedures
assumptions: Users have smartphones with iOS 12+ or Android 8+
Internet connectivity available for initial setup and periodic sync
Users consent to data collection per regional regulations
Third-party services (exchange rates, payment gateways) remain available
Regional app stores permit financial applications
Local storage of at least 100MB available on devices
openQuestions: What specific financial regulations apply in each target country?
Should the app support business accounts or only personal?
What third-party integrations are required (banks, payment providers)?
What is the expected user volume and scaling requirements?
Should the app support family/shared accounts?
What level of financial advice/insights should be provided?
Are there specific Islamic banking requirements for UAE/Pakistan?
What languages should be supported beyond English?
What is the monetization model (subscription, freemium, ads)?
What level of customer support will be provided?
Should the app integrate with accounting software?

traceability.notes: Authentication is critical for all other features
Budget management depends on transaction tracking
Reporting requires transaction and budget data

epics: User Management - Authentication and account management
Financial Tracking - Transaction and expense management
Financial Planning - Budgets, goals, and reminders
Security & Compliance - Data protection and regulatory adherence
Mobile Features - Offline support and mobile-specific capabilities
definitionOfDone: Code reviewed and approved by at least two team members
Security scan completed with no critical issues
QA testing completed and signed off
sprintPlanning: Sprint 1-2: User authentication and core infrastructure (US-1, FR-1)
Sprint 3-4: Basic expense tracking functionality (US-2, FR-2)
Sprint 9-10: Security and compliance implementation (US-6, FR-6)
Sprint 11-12: Offline mode and synchronization (US-7, FR-7)
Sprint 15-16: Bill reminders and notifications (US-8, FR-8)
Sprint 17-18: Testing, bug fixes, and performance optimization
Sprint 19-20: Regional compliance verification and deployment preparation
